requested_items.objective: Consume the corrected Phase 2 schedule and measured router primitive, then emit a conservative measured-router closure artifact for Llama7B.

expected_result.reason: The result should record a conservative no-reroute drain-time upper bound, a router-area lower bound, and an activity-dependent router-power estimate while keeping the remaining full-mesh and memory gaps explicit.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Accept only the exact corrected 8-wave/128-tile Phase 2 v2 artifact and the exact p5/w256/vc4/d4 segmented-router primitive. Treat no-reroute timing only as an upper bound, router area only as a lower bound, and router power only as an activity-dependent estimate. Do not treat any component sum as aggregate placed-mesh PPA.
